title: Black Clover
subtitle: Magic is everything, but I'll prove them wrong.

reflection.quote: Even without magic, I will become the Wizard King!
reflection.author: Asta

thePhilosophy.heading: Never Giving Up is My Magic
paragraphs: In a world where magic is everything, Asta is born with none. While everyone else relies on natural talent and mana, he builds his body and relies purely on his unbreakable spirit.
Black Clover isn't just about underdogs; it's about the relentless refusal to accept the limitations the world places on you.

cascadeOfThoughts.thought: Can hard work really surpass natural talent?
When everyone looks down on you, do you shrink or shout louder?

cinematicMoment.title: Asta's Grimoire.
cinematicMoment.body: When hope seemed completely lost and he was about to give up his dream, a corrupted, five-leaf grimoire chose him. It didn't grant him magic—it gave him the power to destroy it.

cards.title: Misfits
cards.text: A squad made entirely of outcasts, rejects, and bizarre personalities who somehow form the strongest family.

altMemories.question: What separates Asta and Yuno?
altMemories.heading: Two paths, one destination.
altMemories.body: Yuno is loved by mana; Asta is rejected by it. Yet, they both push each other to the absolute limit. Their rivalry isn't built on hatred, but on pure, absolute mutual respect.
altMemories.caption: A rivalry without toxicity.
